comment: Advisories this repository knowingly carries, with the reason. Anything not
listed here fails scripts/audit.mjs. An entry that no longer matches any
advisory also fails it: the fix landed, so the exception has to go.
Severity is recorded as npm reports it, never lowered to pass.

exceptions.title: Elliptic Uses a Cryptographic Primitive with a Risky Implementation
why: No released version fixes it: the advisory covers <=6.6.1, and 6.6.1 is
the newest published version. There is nothing to upgrade to.
It arrives as circomlibjs -> ethers -> elliptic. circomlibjs is used here
for one thing, the Poseidon hash, and its Ethereum helpers are never
called, so elliptic is installed but never runs.
It is a build-time dependency of the circuit workspace: not in the
program, not in the relayer, not shipped to a browser.
